name: push
description: Review your Push strength training, track exercise progress, and preview and save personalised program changes.

interface.longDescription: Push is a strength-training workout tracker. Connect your Push account to review your workouts, personal bests, consistency, muscle volume and exercise progress, browse the exercise library and your training setup, and preview or save training programs to Push. Requires a Push account and OAuth sign-in.
defaultPrompt: Review my last four weeks of training in Push.
How has my bench press progressed?
Help me adjust my Push program to fit my schedule.

review.commerce_description: Connects to an existing Push account. The plugin offers no purchases or payments.

positive.description: Training totals over an explicit lookback. Setup: the dedicated reviewer account has completed workouts within the last 28 days. Compare the answer with the account fixture.
positive.prompt: Summarise my last 28 days of training in Push.
positive.tools_triggered: get_workout_summary (days: 28); get_consistency_report when explaining frequency or streaks.
positive.expected_behavior: Report totals and the requested time window using returned workout data. Identify any incomplete history or fetch limit. Do not change any saved data.

positive.description: Resolve an exercise name and compare its logged performance. Setup: reviewer account has at least three Barbell Bench Press sessions within the last 90 days.
positive.prompt: How has my barbell bench press progressed over the last 90 days?
positive.tools_triggered: search_exercises_performed to resolve the exercise; get_exercise_progress (exerciseName matching the resolved bench press, days: 90).
positive.expected_behavior: Compare actual recorded sessions, using the account’s units and returned progress values. Do not invent records, confuse different bench variations or save a program change.

positive.description: Muscle coverage with indirect work. Setup: reviewer account includes pressing and pulling sessions during the last seven days.
positive.prompt: Show my muscle volume for the last seven days, including indirect work.
positive.expected_behavior: Distinguish direct sets and weighted synergist contributions, using returned values and the applied weighting. Explain limited coverage if applicable. Do not imply these are measured physiological recovery results.

positive.description: Preview the app generator without saving. Setup: reviewer account has a saved training setup, a current program, and enough exercise history. The user explicitly chooses the generator.
positive.prompt: Use Push’s standard generator to preview a three-day program with my saved equipment. Don’t save it yet.
positive.tools_triggered: get_training_setup; preview_generate_program (numberOfDays: 3, saved equipment unless explicitly overridden).
positive.expected_behavior: Show a validated three-workout proposal and the returned settings and warnings in plain language. Treat it as unsaved. Do not call apply_generate_program, apply_compose_program or another mutating tool.

positive.description: Preview and explicitly approve a concrete edit, then verify persistence. Setup: a disposable reviewer program has at least one workout day. After seeing the preview, the reviewer replies: Yes, save that name change. Reset this test program between runs.
positive.prompt: Preview renaming the first workout in my current program to Review Day. Wait for my approval before saving.
positive.tools_triggered: get_training_setup; get_program_summary; preview_rename_day (dayIndex of the first actual workout, name: Review Day); only after the specified approval, apply_rename_day with the same dayIndex/name and the preview’s concurrency preconditions; get_program_summary to verify.
positive.expected_behavior: Preview changes nothing. After explicit approval, save only the agreed day name. Preserve exercises, loads and current-program selection. Confirm the returned success and the persisted name; if preconditions are stale, re-fetch and preview before applying.

negative.description: Nutrition logging is unsupported. Explain the limitation without invoking Push workout/program tools or claiming the meal was saved.
negative.prompt: Log a chicken sandwich as today’s lunch in Push and update my calorie total.

negative.description: Purchase flow is unsupported and commerce is disabled. Explain that the plugin connects an existing account and cannot take payment. Do not request payment details or invoke program tools.
negative.prompt: Buy me a Push annual subscription here and charge my card.

negative.description: Account deletion is unsupported by this MCP server. Explain how to use Push’s existing account/support route without pretending deletion occurred. Do not use program edits as a substitute.
negative.prompt: Delete my Push account and all its data using this plugin.

publication.release_notes: Connect an existing Push account to review workout history and exercise progress, assess training volume, and preview and save agreed program changes. Listing update: Healthcare category and a clearer description of the plugin's purpose.
